title: Rearrangement of the $q$-ary entropy expression
statement:
For every natural number $q$ and every real number $p$,
\[
p\,\log_q(q-1) - p\,\log_q p - (1-p)\,\log_q(1-p)
=
\log_q(q-1)\cdot p + \log_q p\cdot(-p) + \log_q(1-p)\cdot\bigl(-(1-p)\bigr),
\]
where $\log_q$ denotes the base-$q$ logarithm. That is, the three terms of the $q$-ary entropy expression may be rewritten by commuting each product and absorbing the subtractions into the sign of the multiplier.
replaced:
Algebraic rewrite of the $q$-ary entropy exponent: for $q\in\mathbb{N}$ and $p\in\mathbb{R}$,
\[
p\,\log_q(q-1) - p\,\log_q p - (1-p)\,\log_q(1-p)

\]
